before: Boating accidents in Charleston Harbor involve complex jurisdictional questions because federal maritime law, South Carolina state law, or both may apply depending on the vessel type and location of the incident. Common causes include operator inexperience, boating under the influence, and wake violations. Liability may fall on boat operators, rental companies, vessel owners, or government entities responsible for navigation aids. South Carolina's three-year statute of limitations (S.C. Code SS 15-3-530) applies to most state-law boating claims, though federal maritime claims have separate deadlines.
